veranderings.blok: Vlieg is meer as net opstyg
veranderings.rede: 'Voordat daar 'n enjin was' reads as if engines did not exist yet; the sense is that the brothers had no engine yet.

veranderings.voor: Die enjin het nie daardie vlugte lank gemaak nie
veranderings.na: Die enjin het daardie vlugte nie lank gemaak nie
veranderings.rede: With a definite object, 'nie' naturally follows the object in Afrikaans, and it then negates 'lank' precisely.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Dit gly stadig al laer / deur die lug om hom
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: Together these give 'Dit gly stadig al laer deur die lug om hom': the subject is 'dit' but the pronoun is 'hom' in one sentence, and the block 'Wat 'n enjin verander het' uses 'hy' for the glider. A person may want one pronoun throughout ('om dit' or 'Hy gly'); I did not change it because both wordings are protected.
